9978a77a49.q: What is the correlation between global crude oil prices above $100 per barrel and corn prices at $6 or higher?
9978a77a49.a: Going back to the beginning of 2000, there were roughly 54 months where global crude was above 100 dollars a barrel. Of those 54 months, there was only 12 where global corn wasn't at least $6. When you have $100 crude, you have $6 corn—that's how the math has worked out historically.

4d19d6bdc6.q: What percentage of U.S. farm net income came from government subsidies in 2025?
